_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tiririt da Klondike Solitaire. Lmeɛna-k inu d aselkem akken ad teskecem akk tikitiwin ɣer teɣziwin n tuzzma.

Tawurta n Ureqqas:
- Teɣziwin n tuzzma (F1-F4): Rnu ɣef uɛeqqas seg Ace ɣer Tagellid s tɣawsa
- Teɣziwin n tafla (T1-T7): Rnu ɣef uɛeqqas, azegzaw fell-as aberkan, aberkan fell-as azegzaw
- Aɣraf: Ssekcem tikitiwin ɣer teɣzi n yifuɣaren
- Ifuɣaren (W): Tikiti tis kraḍ taɛejbet i wureqqas

Isemyifen:
- 'draw' - Ssekcem tikitiwin seg uɣraf ɣer teɣzi n yifuɣaren
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Ssekcem tikitiwin seg yiwet teɣzi ɣer nniḍen
  Imudiren: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count daɣen 'all', i d-yettanaf ad teskecem akk tikitiwin ttwafiren.
- 'forfeit' - Freq ureqqas tura d tuqqnaḍ di tmaneɣt-k yimira
- Isemawen n teɣziwin: W (ifuɣaren), F1-F4 (teɣziwin n tuzzma), T1-T7 (teɣziwin n tafla)

Tzemreḍ ad texdem aṭas n tigawin di yiwet n tukkirt s usenqed-nsent s ticomma:
  Amedya: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kan Tagellid i zemren ad tt-rren ɣer teɣziwin n tafla ttwaggiz.
Tigawin tt-ureqqsen s leḥrir - ma yella yiwet ur teddi, tigawin nniḍen ad tt-rren.
Seqdec 'forfeit' ma tettamneḍ d akken ureqqas ur yezmir ara ad yaweḍ.
